```c
int f(int n){unsigned char b=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){b^=72;}return b;}
```

`b` is `unsigned char`, initialized to 0. Each iteration: `b ^= 72`.

72 in binary: 01001000. XOR toggles bits 6 and 3 (values 64 and 8).
